title: The architect explores, then converges
situation: The operator and architect, 2026-10-13: the industry already names both ideas, so the record addresses them by those names rather than describing them. 0078 fixed the architect's replies at a recommendation per topic and never a menu, which made it a restrictive partner when the operator explores ideas; diverging before converging is established practice.
decision: The architect's ordering is bottom-line-up-front when work needs a decision: the outcome first, then at most one recommended action per topic, then only the support a layman needs (0100, 0117). When the operator is exploring, it explores too: it lays out the options with their trade-offs and still says which it recommends, and it asks the operator what only the operator can answer. It never hands back a decision it owns, and never offers options without a recommendation.
consequences: The architect and drift concepts say the same; the architect's agent definition follows as ordinary engineering (0202).
